def forward(groups):
    id_part = int(groups[0])
    timestamp_part = int(groups[3])
    combined = id_part * 10000000000 + timestamp_part
    return {'stored': [combined], 'layout': [len(groups[1]), len(groups[2])]}  # Store space lengths in layout

def inverse(record):
    combined = int(record['stored'][0])
    id_part = combined // 10000000000
    timestamp_part = combined % 10000000000
    space1_len = record['layout'][0]
    space2_len = record['layout'][1]
    return f"{id_part}{' ' * space1_len}<node>{' ' * space2_len}{timestamp_part}"
